shadow (shadow42@geocities.com) wrote:

: Aside from that... even if FC *did* like people and start a group... no
: one would pay attention to their message unless they did something
: outrageous.

: How many people would have read the Heaven's gate web page
: if the members hadn't killed themselves? How many people would be
: curious enough to want to read even one page of "Turner Diaries" if one
: of its readers hadn't blown up 100 some people? 

Well.... There's other things people can do, besides sending letter bombs
out and possibly aiming to kill people. However anyone might justify
murder, and whatever anyone might think about politically-motivated
killing, it's still murder, and that DOES turn people off a bit. From a
pragmatic perspective, it's better to do "something outrageous" if it
doesn't TRULY outrage people.

Hell, even Greenpeace initially started out as "just a bunch of guys",
didn't they? They were just lucky enough to reach a critical mass where
they became a self-perpetuating organization. And they didn't kill anyone,
and a few of them got killed by the State, which helped their image.
